state_contract: Host config and catalog_path; pause, identity, receipt and source-hash protections unchanged

bundles__verify_bundle.description: Reject corrupt, encrypted, unsafe, non-regular or oversized archives; return manifest_files (null when absent). Cache reuse also verifies source identity.

ask_once.signature: ask_once(prompt, files=None, answer_timeout=900, *, model='GPT-6', thinking_high=True, state_dir=None, foreground=False, poll_interval=10, upload_timeout=180, bundle_dir=None)

side_effects: ZIP接口只做文件打包/校验；桌面交互接口需要显式授权，未知提交不重发。
selection_and_retention: 主科学任务使用GPT网页；此登记工具保留，因为制卡/核验的ZIP准备和核对实际依赖它。桌面交互仍须原显式前台授权，不随整理启动。原工具源码与公开根导入保持兼容。 独立ZIP工具不依赖主流程core；独立安装时显式传bundle_dir或CODEX_CHAT_ZIP_DIR。
